**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity), NONCOMPETE.**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** § 12.4 (p0050) is the only restriction binding Customer; a document-wide search for "competes", "shall not", exclusivity and field-of-use language surfaced no other Customer-side covenant (all other "shall not" obligations bind Vendor, and § 13.4 is a standard use restriction, not a non-compete). § 12.3 (p0049) expressly disclaims any non-compete.
- **Why it fails:** 24 months post-term, undefined scope ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), any territory, no internal-development or acquisition carve-out — walk-away, and squarely contradictory to § 12.3.
- **Cure (preferred, single surgical replace):** "During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not" → "Customer may", leaving the remainder of the sentence verbatim as an affirmative permission. This removes the restriction, keeps numbering intact, and resolves the internal conflict with § 12.3; the fallback (named product, term only, 12 months, carve-outs) is offered in the comment.
